meta.description: Classic cocktail specifications. Quantities follow the International Bartenders Association official list (2024 revision) as published at iba-world.com, except where a cocktail carries a 'spec_adjusted' note. All other text is original.
meta.conventions: Enum fields (unit, category, preparationMethod, ice, style) use the values of @bespoke/schema. A null unit marks an unmeasured line (to top, to taste) or a countable item, where quantity is a piece count.
